release.identityRule: The packager and verifier require every public legal asset and its signed-app resource counterpart to be byte-identical.

auditInputs.method: The runtime roster establishes the staged byte closure. Local installed-formula licenses and lockfile package licenses supply the checked-in notice corpus.

versionQualification.rule: A Mach-O install-name suffix is an ABI/library version and is not sufficient evidence of the source package version or Homebrew formula revision. Use the stated primary source and the staged runtime roster together.

zstdScopeQualification.upstreamLicenseChoice: The root zstd LICENSE permits the BSD alternative; the release records that BSD alternative for the shipped dylib.
zstdScopeQualification.alternativeText: The full GPL-2.0 text is retained because zstd publishes it as the alternative upstream license, not because this release selects it.
zstdScopeQualification.gplTextNormalization: Homebrew's COPYING file ends without a terminal line feed. The checked-in full text adds one terminal LF only; all license characters before that normalized line ending match the local source.
zstdScopeQualification.sourceArchiveSbomLicenseConcluded: (BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only) AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT
zstdScopeQualification.ancillaryScope: BSD-2-Clause and MIT are conservative whole-source-archive ancillary disclosures. The archive-level SBOM is not file-level evidence and does not establish that either ancillary component is present in the staged libzstd dylib.

evidenceCeiling: This record identifies the audited release composition and checked-in notice assets. It does not by itself prove runtime execution, signature trust, notarization, provider availability, target-game import, GPU execution, visual approval, or performance.
